cards.title: The Eleventh Lantern Fails
cards.description: Mira is on the docks when the eleventh tide lantern gutters out. By dawn the water has risen a hand's width.

cards.title: Hesk's Warning
cards.description: Old Hesk admits the lanterns were never meant to burn forever. Someone has been paying for their oil, and has stopped.

cards.title: The Stolen Ledger
cards.description: The lamplighters' ledger is gone, and its last page was torn out by someone who knew where to look.

cards.title: Cold Open: The Tideway Run
cards.description: Years earlier, a boy smuggles lantern glass past the Wardens and hears a voice in the dark water that knows his name.
cards.notes: A second start into the same chain: Story Checks points it out, which is fine for a cold open.

cards.title: A Smuggler's Offer
cards.description: Tobias Quill has the missing ledger page, and wants Mira's lantern key in exchange.

cards.title: The Warden Hall
cards.description: Mira takes the ledger to the Tide Wardens. Captain Ilse Varn listens far too calmly.
cards.notes: Ilse is introduced here only on this road: the ★ is worked out per branch.

cards.title: Captain Ilse's Test
cards.description: Ilse will help if Mira can relight a dead lantern alone, at high tide.

cards.title: The Locked Archive
cards.description: Behind the archive door: oil receipts signed by Ilse, paid to no one Mira has heard of.

cards.title: Search Ilse's Quarters
cards.description: Mira slips into the captain's rooms and finds a map of the Drowned Market.
cards.notes: Not placed yet: Story Checks lists it as a dead end until it leads somewhere.

cards.title: Night Crossing
cards.description: Tobias poles Mira through the flooded lanes, past lanterns that have already gone dark.

cards.title: The Drowned Market
cards.description: Stalls under a foot of seawater, lit by stolen lantern light. Everyone here owes someone.

cards.title: Lost in the Flooded Lanes
cards.description: A wrong turn. Once the water covers the street names, every lane looks the same.

cards.title: Follow the Bell-Buoys
cards.description: Hesk always said the bell-buoys ring towards the market. He was right, which is the problem.
cards.notes: This closes a loop back to the market. A loop is one stop on a route.

cards.title: Bargain with the Tidewright
cards.description: Under the market, the Tidewright offers to hold back the sea for one more year, for a price.

cards.title: The Lantern Engine
cards.description: Both roads end at the machine under the city that feeds the lanterns. Its last valve is in Mira's hands.

cards.title: Relight Every Lantern
cards.description: Mira pours the stolen oil back into the engine. Merrow stays dry and owes nobody.

cards.title: Let the Sea In
cards.description: Mira opens the sluices. The city floods slowly enough for everyone to leave, and the Tidewright goes hungry.

cards.title: Keep the Bargain
cards.description: Tobias pays the Tidewright's price himself. The lanterns burn, and he never comes back up.
cards.notes: Marked with the tag Ending rather than the status, so it can still say Idea.

cards.title: The Festival of Wicks
cards.description: Every lantern in Merrow lit at once. An opening for book two?
cards.notes: No arrows yet, so Story Checks lists it.

# Board \*title\*

## Start Here

### Try: Story Checks

Ctrl+Shift+K. A dead end, two starts, a loop and a card with no arrows are left in on purpose. Click a finding to find its cards.

### Try: Read a Path

Right-click “The Eleventh Lantern Fails” → Read from here. At each branch, pick a road by its arrow label.

### Try: Routes

Ctrl+Shift+O lists every way from a start to an ending. Three routes have names and notes: expand them with ▸.

### Try: Highlights and Threads

Select a card and press H for what comes before and after it. Ctrl+T follows one character through the story.

### Try: Strands

Ctrl+Shift+B lists every character, place and tag, with a description and fields such as Age. Click ▸ on a strand card below to read them there.

### Try: Fold a Group

World Notes is folded to its title bar: click ⊞ to open it. Select a group and press C to fold it; Shift+C folds them all.

## Act I: The Dimming

### Chapter 1: Last Light

#### The Eleventh Lantern Fails

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Old Hesk · **Locations:** Merrow Docks · **Status:** Final · **Tags:** Clue

Mira is on the docks when the eleventh tide lantern gutters out. By dawn the water has risen a hand's width.

#### Hesk's Warning

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Old Hesk · **Locations:** Hesk's Workshop · **Status:** Revised

Old Hesk admits the lanterns were never meant to burn forever. Someone has been paying for their oil, and has stopped.

*Next: The Stolen Ledger*

### Chapter 2: The Ledger

#### Cold Open: The Tideway Run

**POV:** Tobias Quill · **Locations:** Merrow Docks · **Status:** Draft · **Tags:** Flashback

Years earlier, a boy smuggles lantern glass past the Wardens and hears a voice in the dark water that knows his name.

*Next: A Smuggler's Offer (years earlier)*

#### The Stolen Ledger

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Locations:** Hesk's Workshop · **Status:** Draft · **Tags:** Clue

The lamplighters' ledger is gone, and its last page was torn out by someone who knew where to look.

#### A Smuggler's Offer

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Tobias Quill · **Locations:** Merrow Docks · **Status:** Draft

Tobias Quill has the missing ledger page, and wants Mira's lantern key in exchange.

*Next: The Warden Hall (trust the Wardens) · Night Crossing (take Tobias's offer)*

## Act II: Two Roads

### The Warden's Road

#### The Warden Hall

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Captain Ilse Varn · **Locations:** Warden Hall · **Status:** Draft

Mira takes the ledger to the Tide Wardens. Captain Ilse Varn listens far too calmly.

#### Captain Ilse's Test

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Captain Ilse Varn · **Locations:** Warden Hall · **Status:** Outline · **Tags:** Action

Ilse will help if Mira can relight a dead lantern alone, at high tide.

*Next: The Locked Archive · Search Ilse's Quarters (optional)*

#### Search Ilse's Quarters

**Characters:** Mira Fenn · **Locations:** Warden Hall · **Status:** Idea

Mira slips into the captain's rooms and finds a map of the Drowned Market.

#### The Locked Archive

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Locations:** Warden Hall · **Status:** Outline · **Tags:** Clue, Twist

Behind the archive door: oil receipts signed by Ilse, paid to no one Mira has heard of.

*Next: The Lantern Engine*

### The Smuggler's Road

#### Night Crossing

**POV:** Tobias Quill · **Characters:** Mira Fenn · **Status:** Draft · **Tags:** Action

Tobias poles Mira through the flooded lanes, past lanterns that have already gone dark.

#### The Drowned Market

**POV:** Tobias Quill · **Characters:** Mira Fenn · **Locations:** The Drowned Market · **Status:** Draft

Stalls under a foot of seawater, lit by stolen lantern light. Everyone here owes someone.

*Next: Lost in the Flooded Lanes (take the side canal) · Bargain with the Tidewright*

#### Bargain with the Tidewright

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Tobias Quill · **Status:** Idea

### The Lantern Engine

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Tobias Quill, Captain Ilse Varn · **Locations:** The Lantern Engine · **Status:** Outline

*Next: Relight Every Lantern (relight) · Let the Sea In (flood the city)*

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Characters:** Tobias Quill · **Locations:** The Lantern Engine · **Status:** Ending

Mira opens the sluices. The city floods slowly enough for everyone to leave, and the Tidewright goes hungry.

**POV:** Mira Fenn · **Locations:** The Lantern Engine · **Status:** Ending
